root_cause.root_cause: Cascading Failure — Database Down → Services Timing Out
root_cause.why: A database failure is causing a cascading effect across your entire stack. When the database goes down, connection pools in the app/API containers fill up, requests start timing out, health checks fail, and eventually services crash or restart. The root cause is the database — everything else is a symptom.
fix_steps: FIRST: fix the database container (see database_down fixes above)
Add `depends_on` with health checks in docker-compose.yml so services wait for DB
Implement a connection retry strategy with exponential backoff in your app
Set appropriate connection pool timeouts to fail fast rather than queue
Add circuit breakers so downstream services degrade gracefully when DB is unavailable
Set up DB container restart policy: `restart: always` or `restart: on-failure`
